# Batch Compressor

> Terminal app that batch-compresses photos and videos in a folder. Interactive wizard (Ink TUI). Does not keep results that are larger than the original.

This file helps language models navigate the project. Prefer linked docs over guessing.

## User docs

- [README](readme.md): short end-user guide (run, ffmpeg, hotkeys)
- [Example screenshot](docs/assets/example-1.png)

## For coding agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture (MVP Presenter), stack, conventions, where to change what

## Quick facts

- Entry: `npm start` → `dist/tui/cli.js` (`source/tui/cli.tsx`)
- MCP: `npm run mcp` → `dist/mcp/cli.js` (`source/mcp/cli.ts`) — stdio Model Context Protocol over `SessionPresenter`
- Domain: `source/core/` (no React). UI + adapters: `source/tui/`. MCP: `source/mcp/`
- Photos: `sharp`. Videos: system `ffmpeg` only (never the npm `ffmpeg` package)
- UI language: OS locale via `os-locale` — `ru*` → Russian, else English (`source/tui/i18n/`)
- Logs: `batch-compressor-*.log` in the target folder; EN settings/summary keys; resume from previous logs
- License: MIT (see `package.json`)
- Node.js ≥ 18

## MCP tools (stdio)

Typical flow: `boot` → `configure` → `scan` → `start_compression` → `session_status` / `await_completion`.

Also: `continue_photos_only`, `install_ffmpeg`, `cancel_confirm`, `skip_video`, `set_video_workers`, `open_folder`.

Resources: `batch-compressor://session`, `://summary`, `://log`. Prompt: `compress_folder`.
